championship_bridge.excluded: Pre-2013 source regime, missing shot rows, shots-on-target exceeding shots
championship_bridge.observation: Division/home-adjusted season shot ratios with sampling variance; pooled errors-in-variables bridge
championship_bridge.scope: Pre-season priors scored against noisy first-ten PL xG proxies; not latent-state coverage or match-forecast evidence

conditional_goals.assumption: M8 G|X ~ Poisson(X); realized xG diagnostic only
